findings.title: Reserved source metadata names lose their original declaration and parameter spans
reproduction: Start with spec/successor/examples/source-defined-payment.mori; replace state paid: UInt128; with state some: UInt128;.
Alternatively replace parameter first: Quantity with some: Quantity.
Run check through createFinancialAgreementSourceV1 or the normal CLI. Prefixed Unicode reproductions are reserved-state.mori and reserved-param.mori in this audit directory.
findings.expected: Source span identifies the original offending declaration/parameter. Semantic rejection still exits 1 with empty stdout.
findings.impact: Violates the stated source-diagnostic acceptance requirement; consumers cannot locate these declaration/parameter failures. Rejection itself remains atomic.
findings.cause: validateSourceSchemaNames(normalized) throws an unlocated ExpressionFailure before source-aware parameter validation; it has no retained AST site.
findings.recommendedRepair: Validate schema-name rules against original declaration, field and parameter AST sites using a shared name predicate before or alongside schema validation. Preserve existing error rules and use the referring original node; do not change generic transport diagnostics.

findings.title: Cycles through Operation references bypass the source-aware cycle walk
reproduction: In the example replace payer: Text; in RepayFields with payer: Operation<Repay>;.
Run check through the API or CLI against audit-01/operation-cycle.mori.
findings.expected: Reject the malformed protected record/cycle with an original source span covering its offending field/type reference.
findings.impact: Malformed Repay binding/cycle diagnostics fail the original-source location requirement. No invalid financial execution was observed.
findings.cause: walkRecordCycles unwraps Option/Collection but follows only Record edges; the shared validateSchema later detects Operation→record cycles without source locations before operationBinding runs.
findings.recommendedRepair: Extend the source-aware cycle traversal to follow Operation→bound-record references with the original referring TypeNode span, retaining the shared schema validator as validation rather than duplicating financial binding rules.
